about.title: Custom court exclusion dates
howToUse: Add one object per cancelled or non-session date.
court: exact court name as it appears in schedules.json (e.g. "Canton", "Malone").
reason: optional note (holiday week, judge conference, etc.).
If court is "*" the date is excluded for ALL courts.
Leave the examples in place or delete them after you add real dates.

exclusions.reason: EXAMPLE – court closed day before Christmas. Delete this entry.
EXAMPLE – day after Thanksgiving often closed county-wide. Delete if not needed.
